elements.title: Tenrei Ōta (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that birth-control advocate Tenrei Ōta (pictured) changed his name and went into hiding after he was repeatedly arrested for his work?

elements.title: a variety (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a variety of the Mancos columbine was thought to be extinct but was found in its native cave in 2008?

elements.title: Radim Novák (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Radim Novák conceded a goal directly from a corner kick in the first match of the season, but his team went on to win the league?

elements.title: Nishiddho Sompadokiyo (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a rickshaw puller inspired Helal Hafiz to write "Nishiddho Sompadokiyo" during the 1969 East Pakistan mass uprising?

elements.title: Iron Alps Complex Fire (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Iron Alps Complex Fire took nearly $74 million to suppress?

elements.title: Bronze Age necropolis of Byblos (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the undisturbed Bronze Age necropolis of Byblos was discovered in 2019 during excavations of a previously unexplored area of the ancient city?

elements.title: Natalia Maree Belting (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the language of Natalia Maree Belting was said to be "spare, rhythmic, and resonant"?

elements.title: invasive species in the United Arab Emirates (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that almost half of the invasive species in the United Arab Emirates are birds?

elements.title: Phineas and Ferb season 5 (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Ashley Tisdale did not record new screams for Phineas and Ferb season 5 because she was pregnant and did not want to scare her baby?
